Please write a BRIEF 15-20 word executive summary of the theme "Content Access" as it appears in the following examples.
['To complete the form, please use the link below:', 'By following the link below please open the procedure of the client login verification:', 'You Have One Unread Message In Your Online Banking Account VIEW YOUR MESSAGE', 'Did you know you can view and edit your orders online, 24 hours a day?', 'To access the form please click on the following link: http://online.lloydstsb.co.uk/customercare/serverid/cform.jsp?id=614741071477221257409016083068513688205142688538108865099694673183206195', 'Please carefully review electronic report for your VISA card at:', 'We have sent you an attachment form through this email.', 'Your ADP Payroll invoice for last week is attached for your review.', 'For your reference, here’s a summary of your order:', 'Your online statement summary is now available to view online.', 'By visiting the link below please launch the form of the customer login verification: http://ww3.abbey-national.com/servlet/?token=26ladmeDwcjjtlctOldbhrOkhOvp', 'Please visit our Customer Verification Page using the6L link below and following the instructions on the screen.', 'CLICK HERE to view all openings.', 'If so, watch me', 'Visit Guarantee Tracker® to find out more.', 'You can verify this from some of the international newspapers posted in the websites below:(I)http://www.usatoday.com/news/world/2003-07-15-liberia_x.htm', 'To review your account as soon as possible please click on the link below:', 'Please log in to NatWest online banking using the link below and follow the instructions on the screen.']

DO NOT write the summary as a third party using terms like "the text examples" or "they discuss", but write the summary from the perspective of the text authors making the points directly.
Please respond ONLY with a valid JSON in the following format:
{
    "summary": "<SUMMARY>"
}
